la:adj:alsius.html:
alsĭus or alsus, a, um, adj.
algeo
,
chilly, cold, cool (only once in Lucr. and twice in Cic.): alsia corpora,cold bodies,.—The form alsus only in the comp. neutr.: Antio nihil quietius, nihil alsius, nihil amoenius,: Jam ἀποδυτηρίῳ nihil alsius, nihil muscosius, ; cf Rudd. I. p. 179, n. 52.

la:other:Alsium.gloss: an ancient city in Etruria, in modern Italy
senses: an ancient city in Etruria, in modern Italy
